item.title: Introducing Nova-5
item.description: Nova-5 is our most capable model yet, with stronger reasoning and coding. It has a 400K token context window and is available in the API today at $2.50 per 1M input tokens and $10.00 per 1M output tokens.

item.title: Nova-5 mini: fast and affordable
item.description: A smaller, faster sibling of Nova-5 for high-volume workloads. 128K context. Pricing: $0.20 per 1M input tokens, $0.80 per 1M output tokens.
